title: Colour palette
slide_intent: Teach designers to identify a palette through the associations of its colors as well as their reproduction values. This gives each choice a reason beyond taste.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can connect heritage green with the energy of pink and blue while black lends structure across outputs.
demonstration: Four vertical bands present Emotional Green, Activist Pink, Smart Blue and Truth Black. The supporting white reference sits below.
practical_value: Select the named color by its intended role, then use the corresponding print or screen specification in the swatch.

content_islands.name: Role introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the short paragraph beside the core palette explaining the contribution of each hue.

content_islands.name: Core swatches
content_islands.spec: Fill four equal-height vertical panels with the core colors and attach each name and reproduction values near the base.

content_islands.name: Supporting white
content_islands.spec: Give white a separate label and values in the open lower band beneath the four main swatches.
